description: This file contains Redux action creators and related functions for managing custom emojis in the Mattermost application, including fetching, creating, deleting, and searching emojis.

methods.name: setSystemEmojis
methods.description: Sets the global set of system emojis.

methods.name: createCustomEmoji
methods.description: Creates a new custom emoji using the client API.

methods.name: getCustomEmoji
methods.description: Fetches a custom emoji by its ID.

methods.name: getCustomEmojiByName
methods.description: Fetches a custom emoji by its name asynchronously.

methods.name: getCustomEmojisByName
methods.description: Fetches multiple custom emojis by their names asynchronously, batching requests.

methods.name: getCustomEmojisInText
methods.description: Extracts emoji names from text and fetches corresponding custom emojis.

methods.name: getCustomEmojis
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of custom emojis, optionally loading user profiles.

methods.name: loadProfilesForCustomEmojis
methods.description: Loads user profiles for a list of custom emojis.

methods.name: deleteCustomEmoji
methods.description: Deletes a custom emoji by its ID.

methods.name: searchCustomEmojis
methods.description: Searches for custom emojis matching a term.

methods.name: autocompleteCustomEmojis
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for custom emoji names.
